dedupe_keys.name: bank of japan payment and settlement statistics kessai doko

description: Monthly statistics on payment and settlement activity in Japan. The Bank of Japan page lists monthly releases as free PDF downloads, the latest for July 2026 published on 31 August 2026, with notices of changes such as the deletion of SWIFT data in 2018. The July 2026 release covers settlement through BOJ current accounts (BOJ-NET) overall and by sector, intraday overdrafts, Japanese government bond book-entry and DVP settlement, transactions in the Zengin system (large-value and small-value, core-time and more-time), settlement by clearing houses and the central securities depository, electronic money and debit cards. Time series are also available through the BOJ time-series data search site. Coverage is Japan. Caveats: the licence is not stated on the pages read. For simulation it gives daily and monthly payment volumes and values through Japan's core systems, to size the flows at risk if BOJ-NET or Zengin fail, as in past outages. A related catalogue record is the BIS CPMI red book payment statistics.
